description.value: The Pillar (also known as Pillar Rock) is a protected BC Parks site 11 km northwest of Falkland, established to preserve a striking conglomerate stone hoodoo formation. A steep trail leads to the pillar in about 15 minutes, rewarding hikers with a distinctive geological landmark in the Thompson region. The park is a simple day-use natural area with no on-site infrastructure, making it a rugged but scenic detour for cyclists exploring the Falkland-Chase Road corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a natural stone hoodoo (tourism=attraction), and the BC Parks website confirms it is Pillar Park, whose primary role is protecting a unique conglomerate stone pillar accessible via a steep 15-minute trail. The website explicitly states 'potable water is not available in the park,' making water bottle refill a confirmed false. No bike parking, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'The Pillar' refers to the rock formation itself; the managed BC Parks unit is called 'Pillar Park' — minor name mismatch.
No address in OSM record; location described only as 11 km northwest of Falkland on Falkland-Chase Road.
No phone number in OSM; BC Parks general line (1-800-689-9025) is available via website but not specific to this park.
No washrooms confirmed or denied; website is silent on this facility for what is a very basic day-use park.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Pillar Park is a legitimate BC Parks attraction and a scenic detour for touring cyclists on the Falkland-Chase Road, but it has no water, no confirmed washrooms, and no cyclist infrastructure — it meets none of the required WWC criteria. Worth reviewing whether a no-amenity natural viewpoint fits the directory's utility threshold for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The park is co-located across Falkland-Chase Road from Pillar Lake Recreation Site (managed by Recreation Sites and Trails BC), which may offer additional facilities not covered by this record.
